in_marathi.name: Mohit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intoxicated with love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana' which means 'to intoxicate'. Mohit is a name of Lord Krishna, who intoxicated the gopis with his divine love.

in_bengali.name: Mohit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Intoxicated with love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mohit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana' which means 'to intoxicate'. Mohit is a name of Lord Krishna, who intoxicated the gopis with his divine love.
